claims.claim: ServiceNow AI crossed $1 billion in ACV in Q2 2026, while agentic deployments increased ninefold in nine months and the company reported more than 100 billion workflows running annually on its platform.

risks.risk: AI ACV and deployment growth do not alone prove durable incremental margins or defensibility against platform competitors.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental AI gross margin and retention economics were not isolated in the retrieved release.

claims.claim: Q2 subscription revenue grew 24.5% year over year to $3.877 billion, cRPO grew 21% to $13.20 billion, and ServiceNow beat the high end of guidance across topline and profitability metrics while raising full-year subscription-revenue outlook.

risks.risk: Q2 included some U.S. Federal on-premise revenue accelerated from Q3, so quarterly cadence should not be extrapolated mechanically.

unknowns.unknown: Magnitude of normalized growth excluding timing acceleration requires underwriting adjustment.
